title: Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to A to Z Glass & Mirror Inc.: With two (2) one-year renewal options, covering glass and storefront systems and installation at Los Angeles Internatio
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to A to Z Glass & Mirror Inc.: With two (2) one-year renewal options, covering glass and storefront systems and installation at Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, for cost not to exceed $2,345,000 (Daniel Hughes)
summary: A five-year contract, with two one-year renewal options, for A to Z Glass & Mirror to supply and install glass and storefront systems at LAX and Van Nuys, for up to $2,345,000.
